title: Interferon inference under audit: code and resource package
description: Code and complete resource package accompanying the manuscript Interferon inference under audit: training-source overlap and patient-level validation of transcriptomic signatures. Version v1.11 preserves the complete v1.10 analytical resource, frozen public inputs, source-overlap index, eligibility records, reconstructed signatures, all-channel outputs, historical analyses and portable fixed-input verification code. This is a post hoc methods audit; it does not certify independent clinical validation or general ligand-source accuracy. Component licences: original verification code MIT; original audit tables CC BY 4.0; CytoSig matrices and MDM source files GPL v3; HGNC data CC0; other public source-study data retain their original terms. See LICENSE_SCOPE.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
